title: LRU cache with statistics
prompt:
Implement class LRUCache(capacity) in solution.py.

- get(key, default=None): return the value and mark the key most-recently-used; count a hit or a miss.
- put(key, value): insert or update and mark most-recently-used; when over capacity evict the least-recently-used key and count an eviction. Updating an existing key never evicts.
- __len__ and __contains__: membership tests must NOT change recency.
- keys(): keys ordered from least- to most-recently used.
- stats(): dict with integer keys 'hits', 'misses', 'evictions'.
- capacity < 1 raises ValueError.
